new_today_news.headline: Global Bulk Supply of Used Cooking Oil: Sustainable Feedstocks for the 2026 Industrial Market
new_today_news.summary: Cavin Resource highlights UCO as a critical feedstock for renewable energy production, emphasizing circular economy principles and full traceability. The company offers bulk UCO supply for biodiesel, renewable diesel, and SAF production with transparent sourcing and ESG-aligned procurement.

recent_news.headline: San Diego restaurant openings and closings for August 2026
recent_news.summary: San Diego region saw new restaurant openings downtown, Coronado and UTC, along with several longtime local restaurant closures. Notable openings include Chula Tacos' third location, Rei Do Gado Brazilian steakhouse reopening after two-year closure, and new women's sports gastropub One of Us.

recent_news.headline: Darling Ingredients: Renewable Fuel Tailwinds & Margin Expansion Support Upside
recent_news.summary: Analysis of Darling Ingredients' FY26 position, highlighting benefits from higher fat/protein prices and favorable renewable fuel economics. Diamond Green Diesel remains key earnings driver with robust volume growth.

backfill_news.headline: The Growing Strategic Importance of Used Cooking Oil
backfill_news.summary: Analysis of UCO's transformation from waste to strategic feedstock in the energy transition. Discusses UCO's role in renewable fuels, SAF, HVO, and oleochemical production with emphasis on lifecycle carbon reductions and circular economy value.

backfill_news.headline: City addresses garbage collection delays; drivers needed
backfill_news.summary: Shreveport, Louisiana's solid waste division faces a CDL driver shortage, requiring 11 additional drivers. Collection delays have occurred on some routes despite collection days remaining unchanged.
